aiEditorialAssessment.finding: Day forms cover 0 dní, 1 den, 2/4 dny, 5/21/100 dní and fractional dne, without changing canonical decimal digits. Diacritics render in controls and headings.
aiEditorialAssessment.scope: AI review of terminology, caveats and captured UI; not native financial-language approval.
aiEditorialAssessment.remaining: Native grammatical case/gender, one-letter preposition line breaks and financial wording require review; cs-CZ real-device availability is untested.

accessibility.native200PercentZoom: PASS; actual Chrome settingsPrivate browser zoom, outer 1440/640 -> inner 720/320, DPR 2, root font 16px, visual scale 1

speech.controlMocks: PASS; explicit Play, pause/resume/stop, delayed/eventless voices, unavailable/empty/Chinese-only, error and cancellation

visualReview.scope: AI inspected final Discover 1440 selector, detail Pro 768 and Factor Lab Pro 320 contact sheet. Prepublication 77 six-case route sheets were also inspected; final full 462 captures have automated geometry/semantic checks, not a human pixel-by-pixel or native-language sign-off.
